description: B1 pragmatic_nuance: one observable learning goal through exact review assets; human rubric required.

input.idea: Teach the English phrase "I'll think about it" to worldwide non-native intermediate learners (B1 planning level). After this lesson the learner can recognize that it can express genuine consideration or a noncommittal response, and ask a neutral follow-up instead of assuming yes or no. Include contrasting everyday contexts and a short natural dialogue. Explain that context and tone matter; do not claim that it always means refusal or attribute a rule to a nationality. Make exactly 6 slides. Use simple English-first teaching with visual explanation, no mandatory translation. End with one small practice action. CEFR labels are planning guides, not certification.
